authorisation: D77 under The Product Owner's mission of 2026-10-28: make every genuinely implemented module included in the appliance licence available for configuration, including Card Payment and Room Charge, with availability reflecting real installed capability; keep licensing, site switches, readiness and execution permissions separate; no real payment-provider calls, PMS posting, financial transactions, PMS configuration changes, PRE-LIVE or Central deployment, or Go-Live; never claim an unimplemented capability is available; verify on the authorised test appliance; protected delivery.
context: D76 installed the Hotel module and left card payment and room charge uninstalled. The Product Owner asked for every implemented, licensed module to be configurable, with execution kept separate.

High availability and white label were reported deployed by default although nothing implements them.
